t: What Chemical Reaction Pathway Database Is All About
title: What Chemical Reaction Pathway Database Is All About
description: A reaction pathway is the step-by-step route from reactants to products: which bonds break, which form, and what the transition states look like. The Haber-Bosch process (N2 + 3H2 → 2NH3) runs at 400-500°C and 150-250 atm over iron catalysts, feeding half the world's food via fertilizer. Mechanisms explain rates: SN1 reactions go through a carbocation (rate depends only on substrate), SN2 through a backside attack (rate depends on both partners). This database is the complete reaction pathway: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
